I’ll check both providers’ stream conversion and tests, then fix the indices and run the relevant tests. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
The working tree already has regression tests for parallel calls, including interleaved Gemini candidates and LiteLLM argument fragments. I’ll use those and add coverage for LiteLLM’s missing-index fallback. Gemini’s counter will be local to each stream and tracked per candidate.
The index changes are in place. The provider tests ran, but pytest’s summary hook hit a sandbox permission error while inspecting processes. I’ll capture machine-readable results to confirm the test totals and check Vertex AI, which inherits the Gemini implementation.
Implemented stream indexing fixes:

- Gemini numbers tool calls consecutively across chunks, per candidate.
- LiteLLM preserves supplied indices and falls back to chunk position only when the index is missing or `None`.
- Extended regression coverage for fallback behavior and preserving index `0`.

All 203 Gemini, LiteLLM, and Vertex AI tests passed. Pytest’s summary hook encountered a sandbox permission error; JUnit results confirm zero test failures.

+    call_a = {"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"city": "Baku"}}}
+    call_b = {"functionCall": {"name": "get_time", "args": {"tz": "UTC"}}}
+    part_groups = [[call_a], [call_b]] if split_across_chunks else [[call_a, call_b]]
+    resp = [
+        line

+            b"data: "

         assert call_kwargs["stream_options"]["include_usage"] is True
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fallback_index", [None, "missing"])
+async def test_chat_stream_keeps_parallel_tool_call_indices(fallback_index):
+    def make_chunk(*tool_calls):
+        chunk = mock.MagicMock()
+        chunk.id = "chunk"
+        chunk.object = "chat.completion.chunk"
+        chunk.created = 1234567890
+        chunk.model = "gpt-4o"
+        chunk.usage = None
+        choice = mock.MagicMock()
+        choice.index = 0
+        choice.finish_reason = None
+        choice.delta = mock.MagicMock(spec=["role", "content", "tool_calls"])
+        choice.delta.role = None
+        choice.delta.content = None
+        choice.delta.tool_calls = [
+            mock.MagicMock(index=i, id=id_, type="function", function=mock.MagicMock())
+            for i, id_, _, _ in tool_calls
+        ]
+        for tc, (_, _, name, args) in zip(choice.delta.tool_calls, tool_calls):
+            if tc.index == "missing":
+                del tc.index
+            tc.function.name = name
+            tc.function.arguments = args
+        chunk.choices = [choice]
+        return chunk
+
+    async def mock_stream():
+        yield make_chunk((0, "call_a", "get_weather", ""))
+        yield make_chunk((1, "call_b", "get_time", ""))
+        # A later chunk carries arguments for call 1 only.
+        yield make_chunk((1, None, None, '{"tz": "UTC"}'))
+        yield make_chunk((0, None, None, '{"city": "Baku"}'))
+        yield make_chunk(
+            (fallback_index, None, None, ""),
+            (fallback_index, None, None, ""),
+            (0, None, None, ""),
+        )
+
+    with mock.patch("litellm.acompletion", return_value=mock_stream()) as mock_acompletion:
+        provider = LiteLLMProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()), enable_tracing=True)
+        payload = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}], "stream": True}
+        chunks = [c async for c in provider.chat_stream(chat.RequestPayload(**payload))]
+
+    mock_acompletion.assert_called_once()
+    calls = [tc for c in chunks for tc in c.choices[0].delta.tool_calls]
+    assert [tc.index for tc in calls] == [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0]
+    args = {}
+    for tc in calls:
+        args[tc.index] = args.get(tc.index, "") + (tc.function.arguments or "")
+    assert args == {0: '{"city": "Baku"}', 1: '{"tz": "UTC"}'}
+
